summary: HARD road features to exclude; if no feasible route remains, the request fails.
range: Array enum: toll | highway | ferry | service_road | uturn | sharp_turn | left_turn | right_turn | none. ferry excluded by default.
businessRules: Hard filter: unlike avoid, a route MUST honor it. If none exists -> 4xx.

exclude defines: Specify the type of objects/maneuvers that the route should exclude. This is a hard-constraint. The optimizer would exclude the given objects/maneuvers and return feasible, alternative routes. If n…
Each element in exclude must be valid and consistent with related fields.
Valid options: toll, highway, ferry, service_road, uturn, .... Each affects solver behavior differently.
Must stay consistent with: options.routing.avoid. Changes here may require validation of those fields.
Optional field. Omitting uses solver's default behavior (no penalty).
validationRules: No feasible route under the exclusions -> 4xx.
testingGuidance: Negative: exclusions that leave no route -> 4xx.
Positive: test with exclude set to "toll"
Positive: test with exclude set to "highway"
Positive: test with exclude set to "ferry"
Positive: test with exclude set to "service_road"
Positive: test with exclude set to "uturn"
Positive: test with exclude set to "sharp_turn"
Positive: test with exclude set to "left_turn"
Positive: test with exclude set to "right_turn"
Positive: test with exclude set to "none"
